description:
Create five search synonym groups in the Magento admin panel to improve product discoverability. Go to Marketing > SEO & Search > Search Synonyms. Create the following groups (one at a time), setting the Scope to 'All Store Views':

1. laptop, notebook, ultrabook
2. phone, smartphone, mobile, cellphone
3. headphones, earphones, earbuds, headset
4. tshirt, tee, t-shirt
5. jacket, coat, outerwear, parka

Enter terms exactly as listed (comma-separated). If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
